actions.name: print_file
actions.description: Sends a .gcode.3mf file to a printer as a cloud print through the add-on.
actions.title: Print file

device_id.title: Printer
device_id.description: Printer device, as registered by the printer integration.

serial.title: Serial
serial.description: Printer serial number, used when no device is given.

file.title: File
file.description: Path relative to /media/druckwerk, or an absolute path under /media or /share.

bed_leveling.title: Bed leveling
bed_leveling.description: Level the bed before printing: on, off or auto (the printer decides).

flow_cali.title: Flow dynamics calibration
flow_cali.description: Calibrate the flow before printing: on, off or auto. Left out, the bridge keeps its default (on).

vibration_cali.title: Vibration calibration
vibration_cali.description: Run the vibration (resonance) calibration. Left out, the bridge keeps its default (on).

layer_inspect.title: First layer inspection
layer_inspect.description: Inspect the first layer with the printer camera. Left out: off.

nozzle_offset_cali.title: Nozzle offset calibration
nozzle_offset_cali.description: Calibrate the nozzle offset: on, off or auto. For printers with two nozzles. Left out: off.

bed_type.title: Plate type
bed_type.description: The build plate in the printer. auto means the file decides. Left out: auto.

ext_change_assist.title: External spool change assist
ext_change_assist.description: Let the printer help when you change the external spool. Left out: off.

force.title: Force
force.description: Send even if the printer is running or paused.

actions.name: get_printers
actions.description: Returns the printers you may use: status, progress, remaining time and end time, layer, temperatures, AMS trays (unit and slot, type, colour, remaining), HMS errors, the current job and the queue length. Read-only. The serial and the AMS trays feed the other actions.
actions.title: Get printers

printer.title: Printer
printer.description: Only this printer: serial number, printer name or device id. Empty returns all printers you may use.

actions.name: get_queue
actions.description: Returns the print queue: waiting jobs per printer serial and for "any" (each with its 0-based position, as reorder_job takes it), jobs that wait for approval, running jobs and optionally the latest finished jobs. Read-only.
actions.title: Get queue

history_limit.title: History limit
history_limit.description: How many finished jobs to include, newest first. 0 for none.

actions.name: add_to_queue
actions.description: Adds a job to the print queue; it does not start a print. Give exactly one of file (a sliced .gcode.3mf that is already in the share) or slice_job_id (a variant from druckwerk.slice). A person who needs approval creates a job that waits for an admin. Starting is a separate step that needs the person's confirmation.
actions.title: Add to queue

file.title: File
file.description: Name of a sliced .gcode.3mf in the share, or an absolute path under /media or /share to one. Use this or slice_job_id.

slice_job_id.title: Slice job
slice_job_id.description: Job id of a finished slice from druckwerk.slice. Use this or file.

target.title: Target
target.description: Printer serial number or name, or "any" for the first free printer of the model.

model.title: Model
model.description: Printer model for target "any", for example H2S. Needed when the printers have different models.

options.title: Options
options.description: Print options: timelapse, use_ams, vibration_cali, layer_inspect, ext_change_assist as booleans; bed_leveling, flow_cali, nozzle_offset_cali as true, false or auto; bed_type as auto, cool_plate, eng_plate, hot_plate, textured_plate, supertack_plate or 3d_effect_plate.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the print, up to 80 characters. The queue and the live activity show it. Default: the file name without .gcode.3mf.

actions.name: slice
actions.description: Slices a model in good, better and best quality for one printer and AMS tray, and returns print time, filament grams and cost for each variant plus the slice job ids. Long-running: the slicer runs one slice at a time, so expect 1 to 5 minutes per variant and 3 to 15 minutes for the call, which waits up to 30 minutes. With wait false it returns the slice job ids at once; poll them with druckwerk.get_slice. Show the variants to the person, let them choose, then call add_to_queue with the chosen slice_job_id.
actions.title: Slice model

model_file.title: Model file
model_file.description: Absolute path of the model (.stl, .3mf, .obj, .step) under /share or /media.

printer.title: Printer
printer.description: Printer serial number, printer name or device id. You need an active grant on it.

tray.title: Tray
tray.description: Loaded AMS tray as unit:slot, both 0-based, as get_printers lists them. 0:0 is the first slot of the first AMS.

plate.title: Build plate
plate.description: Build plate type. Empty uses the printer's default.

wait.title: Wait
wait.description: Wait for the slices to finish and return their results. False returns the slice job ids immediately.

actions.name: get_slice
actions.description: Returns state, print time, grams and cost of slice jobs, for example after druckwerk.slice with wait false. Read-only.
actions.title: Get slice results

actions.name: cancel_job
actions.description: Cancels a waiting job. Users cancel their own jobs; printer admins cancel any job. A job that already started runs on the printer and cannot be cancelled here.
actions.title: Cancel job

job_id.title: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

actions.name: reorder_job
actions.description: Moves a waiting job to a position in the queue. Users reorder only within the slots of their own jobs; printer admins reorder any job.
actions.title: Reorder job

job_id.title: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

position.title: Position
position.description: New 0-based position among the waiting jobs (of the printer, when printer is set).

printer.title: Printer scope
printer.description: Count positions among the waiting jobs of this printer only. Empty counts all waiting jobs.

actions.name: move_job
actions.description: Changes the target of a waiting job to another printer or to "any". Needs admin on the current and on the new printer.
actions.title: Move job

job_id.title: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

target.title: Target
target.description: New printer serial number or name, or "any".

model.title: Model
model.description: Printer model, needed when the target is "any" and the job has none.

actions.name: skip_job
actions.description: Sends a waiting job to the end of the queue so the next one comes first. Printer admins only.
actions.title: Skip job

job_id.title: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

actions.name: approve_job
actions.description: Approves a job that waits for approval so it becomes queued. Printer admins only.
actions.title: Approve job

job_id.title: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

actions.name: reject_job
actions.description: Rejects a job that waits for approval; it is cancelled. Printer admins only.
actions.title: Reject job

job_id.title: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

actions.name: retry_job
actions.description: Puts a failed or cancelled job from the history back into the queue. Printer admins only.
actions.title: Retry job

job_id.title: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

actions.name: start_next
actions.description: Starts the next queued job on a printer. Printer admins only. SAFETY: this heats and moves a printer. Before calling, show the person the sliced plate review and a current camera snapshot (druckwerk.camera_snapshot), ask whether the plate is clear and the print may start, and call only after an explicit yes. Both plate_clear and confirmed_by_person must be true, otherwise the call is refused.
actions.title: Start next job

printer.title: Printer
printer.description: Printer serial number, printer name or device id. get_printers lists them.

plate_clear.title: Plate clear
plate_clear.description: Must be true: the build plate is empty and clean. Only set it after the person has looked at the current camera snapshot.

confirmed_by_person.title: Confirmed by person
confirmed_by_person.description: Must be true: the person has seen the sliced plate review and a current camera snapshot and explicitly said the print may start. An agent must never set this on its own.

actions.name: start_job
actions.description: Starts a chosen queued job on a printer, skipping the queue order. Printer admins only. SAFETY: this heats and moves a printer. Before calling, show the person the sliced plate review and a current camera snapshot (druckwerk.camera_snapshot), ask whether the plate is clear and the print may start, and call only after an explicit yes. Both plate_clear and confirmed_by_person must be true, otherwise the call is refused.
actions.title: Start job

printer.title: Printer
printer.description: Printer serial number, printer name or device id. get_printers lists them.

job_id.title: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

plate_clear.title: Plate clear
plate_clear.description: Must be true: the build plate is empty and clean. Only set it after the person has looked at the current camera snapshot.

confirmed_by_person.title: Confirmed by person
confirmed_by_person.description: Must be true: the person has seen the sliced plate review and a current camera snapshot and explicitly said the print may start. An agent must never set this on its own.

actions.name: camera_snapshot
actions.description: Takes a current picture from the printer's camera and saves it as /media/druckwerk/<serial>-<time>.jpg; returns the path and a media source id. Takes 10 to 60 seconds when the camera tunnel is closed. Show it to the person before a start. Needs an active grant on the printer.
actions.title: Camera snapshot

printer.title: Printer
printer.description: Printer serial number, printer name or device id. get_printers lists them.

llm.prompt:
Druckwerk manages 3D printers: printer status, the print queue, slicing and starting prints.
Rules:
- You act as the signed-in Home Assistant user. Home Assistant admins and printer owners are admins of their printers.
  Users may add jobs on printers they have an active grant for (some grants need an admin's approval), cancel their own jobs
  and reorder only within their own queue slots. Only admins skip, move, approve, reject, retry and start jobs. A refusal
  starting with "rule:" is final; tell the person, do not try another way round.
- Slicing takes minutes (one slice at a time, three variants good, better and best). Say so before you start, and use
  wait false with druckwerk_get_slice_results when your own call timeout is short.
- Typical flow: druckwerk_get_printers (serial, AMS trays as unit:slot), druckwerk_slice, let the person choose a variant,
  druckwerk_add_to_queue with its slice_job_id. Adding to the queue never starts a print.
- Never start a print on your own. Before druckwerk_start_next or druckwerk_start_job, show the person the sliced plate
  review and a current camera snapshot (druckwerk_camera_snapshot), ask whether the plate is clear and the print may
  start, and call only after an explicit yes, with plate_clear and confirmed_by_person both true. Without both the call is refused.
- Printers are named by serial number, printer name or device id. Job ids are 12 hex characters.

tools.name: druckwerk_get_printers
tools.description: Status of the printers you may use: state, progress, remaining time, end time, layer, temperatures, AMS trays (unit and slot), HMS errors, current job, queue length.

printer.description: Only this printer: serial or name

tools.name: druckwerk_get_queue
tools.description: The print queue: waiting jobs per printer serial and for any (with 0-based position), pending approvals, running jobs, optional history.

tools.name: druckwerk_add_to_queue
tools.description: Add a job to the queue from a sliced file name in the share or from a slice_job_id (give one). Does not start a print.

target.description: Printer serial or name, or any

model.description: Printer model for target any, e.g. H2S

options.description: Print options: timelapse, use_ams, vibration_cali, layer_inspect, ext_change_assist as booleans; bed_leveling, flow_cali, nozzle_offset_cali as true, false or auto; bed_type as auto, cool_plate, eng_plate, hot_plate, textured_plate, supertack_plate or 3d_effect_plate

name.description: Name of the print, shown in the queue and the live activity (80 characters)

tools.name: druckwerk_slice
tools.description: Slice a model (.stl, .3mf, .obj, .step under /share or /media) as good, better and best for one printer and tray; returns time, grams, cost and a slice job id per variant. Takes 3 to 15 minutes; wait false returns the ids at once.

plate.description: Build plate type, default is the printer's

tools.name: druckwerk_get_slice_results
tools.description: State, print time, grams and cost of slice jobs (after druckwerk_slice with wait false).

tools.name: druckwerk_cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a waiting job. Users cancel their own, admins any.

tools.name: druckwerk_reorder_job
tools.description: Move a waiting job to a 0-based position. Users reorder only within their own slots, admins any.

printer.description: Count positions among this printer's waiting jobs

tools.name: druckwerk_move_job
tools.description: Change a waiting job's target printer, or to any. Admins only.

target.description: Printer serial or name, or any

tools.name: druckwerk_skip_job
tools.description: Send a waiting job to the end of the queue. Admins only.

tools.name: druckwerk_approve_job
tools.description: Approve a job waiting for approval. Admins only.

tools.name: druckwerk_reject_job
tools.description: Reject a job waiting for approval. Admins only.

tools.name: druckwerk_retry_job
tools.description: Put a failed or cancelled job back into the queue. Admins only.

tools.name: druckwerk_start_next
tools.description: Start the next queued job on a printer. Admins only. Starting a print needs plate_clear: true and confirmed_by_person: true. Show the person the sliced plate review and a current camera snapshot (druckwerk.camera_snapshot), ask them to confirm the plate is clear and the print may start, and call again only after an explicit yes.

plate_clear.description: True only after the person saw a current camera snapshot

confirmed_by_person.description: True only after the person explicitly said to start

tools.name: druckwerk_start_job
tools.description: Start a chosen queued job on a printer, ahead of the queue order. Admins only. Starting a print needs plate_clear: true and confirmed_by_person: true. Show the person the sliced plate review and a current camera snapshot (druckwerk.camera_snapshot), ask them to confirm the plate is clear and the print may start, and call again only after an explicit yes.

plate_clear.description: True only after the person saw a current camera snapshot

confirmed_by_person.description: True only after the person explicitly said to start

tools.name: druckwerk_camera_snapshot
tools.description: Take a current camera picture; saved under /media/druckwerk, returns its path. Takes up to a minute.
